# حُسِسْتُنَّ (ḥusistunna) /ħu.sis.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of حَسَّ (ḥassa, “to freeze; to curry (a horse)”) and حَسَّ (ḥassa, “to feel, to perceive”)
